# Brightmere

> Brightmere is a working-capital diagnostic consultancy for inventory-heavy mid-market businesses ($15–50M revenue): manufacturing, distribution & wholesale, DTC, and retail. Its one-week "Cash X-Ray" reads a company's actual ledgers line by line - not category averages - to find cash trapped in inventory, receivables, and supplier terms, and sizes every finding in pounds. Typical engagements find six to seven figures of releasable cash ahead of a fundraise, refinance, or exit.

## What Brightmere does

- Cash X-Ray: a one-week diagnostic connecting finance and ERP systems to trace cash from sale to bank, finding where it is trapped and sizing each gap in pounds
- Release: fixing the specific leaks found - inventory discipline, collection priorities, supplier terms
- Cashflow Operating System: a live 13-week cash forecast, early-warning alerts, and an operating cadence that keeps cash visible
